1: // Endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas){ console.error('Canvas with id="game" not found'); return; }
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
8:   // helper to draw rounded rectangles
9:   function drawRoundedRect(x,y,w,h,r,style){
10:     ctx.beginPath();
11:     ctx.moveTo(x+r, y);
12:     ctx.lineTo(x+w-r, y);
13:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w, y, x+w, y+r);
14:     ctx.lineTo(x+w, y+h-r);
15:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w, y+h, x+w-r, y+h);
16:     ctx.lineTo(x+r, y+h);
17:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y+h, x, y+h-r);
18:     ctx.lineTo(x, y+r);
19:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x+r, y);
20:     ctx.closePath();
21:     ctx.fillStyle = style;
22:     ctx.fill();
23:   }
24:   // simple sky gradient
25:   const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
26:   skyGrad.addColorStop(0,'#87CEEB');
27:   skyGrad.addColorStop(1,'#E0F6FF');
28:   // cloud data
29:   const clouds = [];
30:   for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
31:     clouds.push({x:Math.random()*W, y:20+Math.random()*30, r:20+Math.random()*15, speed:0.5+Math.random()*0.5});
32:   }
33:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
34:   const JUMP = -12;
35:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 30;
36:   const OBSTACLE_HEIGHT = 40;
37:   const OBSTACLE_MIN_W = 20;
38:   const OBSTACLE_MAX_W = 60;
39:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
40:   let lastSpawn = 0;
41:   let score = 0;
42:   let gameOver = false;
43:   const player = {x:50, y:H-PLAYER_SIZE, w:PLAYER_SIZE, h:PLAYER_SIZE, vy:0, onGround:true};
44:   const obstacles = [];
45:   function reset(){
46:     player.y = H-PLAYER_SIZE; player.vy=0; player.onGround=true;
47:     obstacles.length = 0; score=0; gameOver=false; lastSpawn=0;
48:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
49:   }
50:   function spawn(){
51:     const w = OBSTACLE_MIN_W + Math.random()*(OBSTACLE_MAX_W-OBSTACLE_MIN_W);
52:     obstacles.push({x:W, y:H-OBSTACLE_HEIGHT, w, h:OBSTACLE_HEIGHT, speed:6});
53:   }
54:   function update(dt){
55:     // player physics
56:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
57:     player.y += player.vy;
58:     if(player.y >= H-PLAYER_SIZE){ player.y = H-PLAYER_SIZE; player.vy=0; player.onGround=true; }
59:     // obstacles movement & collision
60:     for(let i=obstacles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
61:       const o = obstacles[i];
62:       o.x -= o.speed;
63:       if(o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i,1);
64:       // collision
65:         if(!(player.x+player.w < o.x || player.x > o.x+o.w || player.y+player.h < o.y || player.y > o.y+o.h)){
66:           if(!gameOver){
67:             gameOver = true;
68:             playGameOverSound();
69:           }
70:         }
71:     }
72:     // clouds movement (parallax)
73:     clouds.forEach(c=>{
74:       c.x -= c.speed;
75:       if(c.x + c.r < 0) c.x = W + c.r;
76:     });
77:     // spawn timing
78:     if(Date.now()-lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL){ spawn(); lastSpawn = Date.now(); }
79:     score = Math.floor((Date.now()-startTime)/100);
80:   }
81:   function draw(){
82:     // sky background
83:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
84:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
85:     // clouds
86:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
87:     clouds.forEach(c=>{
88:       ctx.beginPath();
89:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
90:       ctx.fill();
91:     });
92:     // ground line
93:     ctx.fillStyle='#654321';
94:     ctx.fillRect(0,H-5,W,5);
95:     // player (rounded green square)
96:     drawRoundedRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h, 5, '#4CAF50');
97:     // obstacles (rounded red rectangles)
98:     obstacles.forEach(o=>drawRoundedRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h, 3, '#D32F2F'));
99:     // score
100:     ctx.fillStyle='#000';
101:     ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
102:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,10,20);
103:     if(gameOver){
104:       ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
105:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
106:       ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
107:       ctx.font='30px sans-serif';
108:       ctx.textAlign='center';
109:       ctx.fillText('Game Over',W/2,H/2);
110:     }
111:   }
112:   let startTime = 0;
113:   function loop(timestamp){
114:     if(!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
115:     const dt = timestamp - (lastFrame||timestamp);
116:     lastFrame = timestamp;
117:     if(!gameOver){
118:       update(dt);
119:       draw();
120:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
121:     } else {
122:       draw();
123:     }
124:   }
125:   // sound setup
126:   const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
127:   const audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
128:   function playTone(freq, duration){
129:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
130:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
131:     osc.type = 'sine';
132:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
133:     osc.connect(gain);
134:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
135:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
136:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
137:     osc.start();
138:     setTimeout(()=>{
139:       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05);
140:       osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.06);
141:     }, duration);
142:   }
143:   function playJumpSound(){ playTone(440, 100); }
144:   function playGameOverSound(){ playTone(150, 300); }
145:   // input
146:   function jump(){ if(player.onGround){ player.vy = JUMP; player.onGround = false; playJumpSound(); } }
147:   document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ if(e.code==='Space') jump(); });
148:   document.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{ e.preventDefault(); jump(); },{passive:false});
149:   // start
150:   reset();
151: })();
